walkthrough:
Identify the binomial model parameters and verify normal approximation conditions:
$$X \sim B(160, 0.70), \quad np = 112 > 5, \quad n(1 - p) = 48 > 5$$

Compute the mean and standard deviation for the approximating normal distribution $Y$:
$$\mu = np = 112$$
$$\sigma = \sqrt{np(1 - p)} = \sqrt{160 \times 0.70 \times 0.30} = \sqrt{33.6} \approx 5.7966$$

Apply the continuity correction for more than 120 residents ($X \ge 121$):
$$\mathrm{P}(X > 120) = \mathrm{P}(X \ge 121) \approx \mathrm{P}(Y > 120.5)$$

Calculate the upper-tail probability from standard normal tables:
$$\mathrm{P}(Z > 1.466) = 1 - \Phi(1.466) = 1 - 0.9287 = 0.0713\text{ (3 s.f.)}$$
teacher_walkthrough:
Step 1: State the exact distribution and test approximation conditions:
Let $X$ be the number of residents in the sample of 160 who own a bicycle.
$$X \sim B(160, 0.70)$$
Check the validity conditions for a normal approximation:
$$np = 160 \times 0.70 = 112 > 5$$
$$nq = 160 \times 0.30 = 48 > 5$$
Since both $np > 5$ and $nq > 5$ are satisfied, a normal approximation $Y \sim N(\mu, \sigma^2)$ is appropriate.

Step 2: Calculate the mean $\mu$ and standard deviation $\sigma$:
$$\mu = np = 112$$
$$\sigma^2 = npq = 160 \times 0.70 \times 0.30 = 33.6$$
$$\sigma = \sqrt{33.6} \approx 5.79655$$

Step 3: Apply the continuity correction:
We need the probability of more than 120 residents: $\mathrm{P}(X > 120)$.
In discrete integers, $X > 120$ means $X \ge 121$.
The integer $121$ is represented by the continuous interval $[120.5, 121.5]$.
Therefore, the region $X \ge 121$ corresponds to:
$$Y > 120.5$$

Step 4: Standardise $Y = 120.5$ to find the z-score:
$$Z = \frac{Y - \mu}{\sigma} = \frac{120.5 - 112}{\sqrt{33.6}} = \frac{8.5}{5.79655} \approx 1.46638 \approx 1.466$$

Step 5: Compute the upper-tail probability using standard normal tables:
$$\mathrm{P}(Z > 1.466) = 1 - \Phi(1.466)$$
From the standard normal cumulative distribution tables:
$$\Phi(1.46) = 0.9279, \quad \text{difference for } 6 = 8 \implies \Phi(1.466) = 0.9287$$
$$\mathrm{P}(Z > 1.466) = 1 - 0.9287 = 0.0713\text{ (3 s.f.)}$$
(Accept values in the range $0.0712$ to $0.0714$).

ai_rubric.Applying a Normal Approximation: Calculates mean = 112, variance = 33.6, applies continuity correction 120.5, standardises to 1.466, and evaluates 0.0713.
